data.name: Khaalud
data.gender_notes: Khaalud is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'khala' meaning 'to return'. This name signifies a person who is eternal and everlasting, one who returns to Allah. The name Khaalud carries the meaning “Eternal, Everlasting” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khaalud usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal, everlasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes a deep connection to Allah and the eternal nature of the soul.
data.etymology: Khaalud belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eternal, Everlasting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khaalud total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: خالد
in_arabic.meaning: خالد تعني الباقي علي قيد الحياة، الشخص الذي لا يموت
in_arabic.long_meaning: خالد هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: الدائم، الباقي، الذي لا يموت. وهو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 58: وَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنُ وَلَكِن لَّيَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَشِيرُ وَالْمُنذِرُ فَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا أَمرَهُم وَقَدْ حَكَمَ اللَّهُ لَيَأْتِيَنَّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ الَّذِي يَعِزُّ فِيهِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَيُخْزَى الْكَافِرُونَ

in_urdu.name: خالد
in_urdu.meaning: خالد مطلب ہے مستقل رہنے والا، زندہ رہنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: خالد ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے دائم، مستقل، زندہ رہنے والا۔ یہ نام اللہ کے 99 ناموں میں سے ایک ہے اور قرآن مجید میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے۔ خالد نام کے حامل شخص کو دائمی اور غیر متغیر ہونے کی خصوصیات سے منسوب کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: खालिद
in_hindi.meaning: खालिद का अर्थ है जो हमेशा के लिए रहता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: खालिद एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है स्थायी, शाश्वत, हमेशा के लिए रहने वाला। यह नाम अल्लाह के 99 नामों में से एक है और कुरआन में भी इसका उल्लेख है। खालिद नाम वाले व्यक्ति को स्थायी और अपरिवर्तनीय होने की विशेषताओं से जोड़ा जाता है

in_pashto.name: خالد
in_pashto.meaning: خالد د ژوندی پاتې کیدو معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: خالد د عربي نوم دی چې معنی یې ده دایمي، پاتې، ژوندی پاتې کیدو. دا نوم د الله تعالی په 99 نومونو کې دی او په قرآن کریم کې هم راغلی دی. خالد نوم لرونکی شخص د دایمي او نه متغیر کیدو صفاتو سره تړلی دی

in_english.name: Khaalud
in_english.meaning: Eternal, permanent, one who lives forever, immortal
in_english.long_meaning: Khaalud is an Arabic name that originates from the root 'kha-lam-dal' which means 'to remain, to stay, to live forever'. It is one of the 99 names of Allah and is mentioned in the Quran. The name Khaalud signifies eternal life, permanence, and immortality. In Islamic tradition, Khaalud is associated with the attribute of Allah being the only one who remains forever. The name implies a sense of stability, continuity, and timelessness. Historically, the name Khaalud has been used in various Muslim cultures to signify the enduring nature of Allah. In modern usage, Khaalud remains a popular name among Muslims worldwide, symbolizing the aspiration for spiritual eternity and divine connection

historical_references.reference: Khaalud was an Umayyad governor of Egypt during the early Abbasid Caliphate. He was known for his military prowess and was appointed by Caliph Harun al-Rashid to quell a rebellion in Egypt. After successfully putting down the rebellion, Khaalud was rewarded with the title of 'Amir al-Juyush' (commander of the army).

Another historical reference for Khaalud is that he was the father of the famous Persian poet, Abu al-Ala al-Ma'arri. Al-Ma'arri is known for his biting satire and was a contemporary of the great poet Omar Khayyam.
